title: Specified completed and condensed open comparison maps
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of positive prime characteristic different from $\ell$. Use the separated finite-type $k$-schemes and coefficient realization data of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-e-realization], the canonical lifted $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$, its fixed algebraic-closure embedding and $V$ of [def-pur-exceptional-reconstruction-presentations], and the completed integral constructible category [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. For an open immersion $j:U\hookrightarrow Y$ over $k$, define its ordinary completed-ring extension, restriction and actual adjunction in the coefficient coordinates of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport]. Define their preservation predicate and their restrictions by the fully faithful constructible inclusions. Define the scalar realization comparison and restriction comparison using the actual scalar-adjunction conjugate of the identity-on-sections restriction square [lem-zl-compact-support-realization-factor-normalization]. Form the trivial compactification $(j,\mathrm{id}_Y)$ and use its specified reconstructed support and $\alpha$ [lem-pur-compact-support-condensed-realization]. A model consists of the supplied coefficient data, actual strict-system operations [def-sf-integral-system-operations], their representative-normalized realization model and canonical bridge [def-sf-integral-system-canonical-bridge], with the coefficient reduction equal to the canonical calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define the integral identification $t_M=d_j(M)\mathcal L_Y(\alpha_M)u_{P_RM}$, writing $d_j=\mathcal L_Y(r_j^{-1})u_{j_!M}^{-1}$ and removing only the system identity proper factor. Define $b_M$ as $V_Y(t_M^{-1})$, then scalar extension of the parent compact-support comparison, the specified condensed projection [def-pur-condensed-compact-support-projection], and the canonical derived identity direct-image unitor. Inverses are represented by the existing inverse-or-zero operation [def-zl-integral-generator-admissibility-inverse] before their invertibility is asserted. Define the factor-normalization predicate requiring the parent comparison to equal its specified proper/open factorization. These are actual constructions and predicates; their isomorphism and counit properties are separate assertions.
